devicePageIntro: Connect your DeskHub and configure its built-in display modes, right here.
deviceConnectionIntro: Connect through its local IP address.
deviceAddressHint: Private IPv4 address, without http://. The server must be able to reach it on port 80. Clear it to unlink.
deviceContextText: API mode displays the content you create in Display. GitHub, Work Timer and X Followers run directly on the device.
deviceWifiNote: Wi-Fi stays in the device's own interface.
deviceSettingsIntro: Choose one of the four built-in modes.
deviceGithubDescription: Show GitHub activity using the device's built-in integration.
deviceApiDescription: Fetch content from this panel or another HTTP endpoint.
deviceTimerDescription: Alternate focus and rest with a built-in timer animation.
deviceXDescription: Show a profile's follower count using the device's X integration.
deviceGithubHint: Uses the device's built-in GitHub mode. For custom commit messages, choose API and configure GitHub in Display.
devicePresetHint: Use this panel's /display endpoint and content key.
deviceApiHint: Use a URL reachable from the DeskHub, not localhost. Do not include credentials or secret tokens.
deviceScrollingHint: Move long messages across the screen.
deviceXHint: Without @. The firmware notes that the initial fetch may take 15–20 seconds.
deviceOverwriteHint: Applying sends the complete display configuration and overwrites the device's settings. This form shows defaults or the last configuration sent from this panel, not a live reading.
deviceNeverSent: No configuration has been sent to this device from this panel yet.
deviceAddressLoaded: Saved IP loaded. Use Check connection to contact the device.
deviceLinkHint: Save the DeskHub's IP address to enable device operations.
deviceAddressError: Enter a private IPv4 address: 10.x.x.x, 172.16–31.x.x or 192.168.x.x. Do not include a URL or port.
deviceNumberError: Enter a whole number between {min} and {max}.
deviceAddressSaved: IP saved on the server. Your form values are kept; no settings have been sent to the device.
deviceAddressReconciled: Saved IP confirmed: {address}. Your IP and configuration drafts are kept. Save the IP draft if it differs before contacting the device.
deviceAddressUnconfirmed: The saved IP could not be confirmed. Your drafts are kept. Retry connection or save the IP to confirm the target before checking or applying settings.
deviceUnlinked: Device unlinked. Its display settings have not been changed.
deviceCompatible: Compatible configuration form found. This check does not read saved settings or change the device.
deviceIncompatible: The device's configuration form is not compatible with this panel. No settings were sent.
deviceUnreachable: Could not read the device's configuration form. Check its IP and connectivity from the server.
deviceApplying: Checking compatibility and sending the display configuration…
deviceApplied: The device acknowledged the submission. The configuration is remembered here; check the physical display for the result.
deviceUnconfirmed: The result could not be confirmed. The device may have applied the settings. Your form values are kept; check the device before submitting again.
deviceBusy: A device operation is already in progress. Wait for it to finish.
deviceConfigurationError: Check the settings in all four modes, including values retained in inactive modes.
deviceStorageError: The IP could not be saved on the server. The previous address is kept.
devicePanelLocalhost: Enter this server's LAN address in the API URL, ending in /display. The DeskHub cannot reach the server through localhost. The JSON key and interval are ready.
devicePanelReady: Panel URL, JSON key and interval added to the draft. Apply to send them to your DeskHub.
githubTemplateHint: You write the message; variables only insert data. Add {{repositories}} if you want repository names and counts.
weatherTemplateHint: You write the message; variables only insert data. {{condition}} uses OpenWeatherMap's description.
invalidTemplateVariable: Use one of the available variables with complete double braces. The buttons below can insert them for you.
variableCity: The city returned by the weather provider
variableTemperature: Rounded temperature in the selected units
variableUnit: C or F, according to the selected units
variableCondition: Description returned by OpenWeatherMap (e.g. clear sky)
integrationsPageIntro: Connect the services behind your display. Manage their keys here, then shape your content on Display.
githubDescription: Your daily contributions, at a glance. Save a token here, then choose a username on Display.
weatherDescription: A little context for your day. Save a key here, then choose a city and units on Display.
credentialsSaveHint: Empty fields keep existing keys. Saving here does not change your display settings.
heading: A space for what matters.
intro: Choose what your DeskHub says. One fixed address, the content you decide.
contentIntro: Choose a source and make it yours.
rotationToggleHint: One source, or a cycle of your favourites.
rotationHint: Choose at least two. The order is Text → GitHub → Weather; each keeps its own message. Use API mode on the device.
rotationInterval: {seconds} s per source, using the last fetch interval sent from Device (60 s by default). Changes made directly on the hardware are not detected.
rotationMinimum: Select at least two sources to save a rotation.
rotationMissing: Configure the integration keys for: {sources}. Or remove those sources from the rotation.
rotationPreviewSource: Preview: {source}. The saved rotation is unaffected.
rotationSkipped: Unavailable sources skipped for this request: {sources}. Check their settings and integrations.
messagePlaceholder: A good day to create something.
textHint: Keep it brief: the device displays text according to its own settings.
githubHint: Up to 39 characters: letters, numbers and hyphens between them.
cityHint: Add a country code to specify the location more precisely.
saveFootnote: Changes apply when saved. The device will pick them up on its next request.
previewIntro: Try the content before saving it.
previewHint: Generate a preview using the form values.
previewFootnote: 32 columns × 7 rows. The bitmap font matches the photographed “Hello” and is clipped to seven rows; alignment and scrolling are simulated, not verified firmware behavior. This preview does not send anything to the device.
ledWaiting: Generate a preview to measure the message.
ledFits: {columns} of 32 columns with this font. Fits without scrolling.
ledOverflows: {columns} columns with this font. The fixed view clips {extra}; simulate scrolling to see the rest.
liveFootnote: Content currently served by the server. This does not confirm what the physical screen is showing.
integrationsIntro: Connect your sources here. Keys are stored encrypted on the server.
tokenPlaceholder: Enter a token to save or replace it
createToken: Create a classic token on GitHub ↗
keyPlaceholder: Enter a key to save or replace it
keyActivation: A new key may take time to activate.
credentialsFootnote: Keys are stored encrypted on your server and are never shown again. “Key saved” confirms storage; generate a preview on Display to check access to the provider. Use the separate remove buttons to delete keys.
connectionIntro: Set this address on the device once.
connectionWarning: Configure DeskHub with a server URL reachable from its network. Do not use localhost or loopback addresses: they would point to the device itself.
capabilitiesError: The server has not confirmed the integration status.
csrfError: The operation could not be authorized. Keep a copy of your changes, then reload the page to renew the security token.
sourceUnavailable: The source is currently unavailable. Check its settings and integration key, then try again.
requestError: The request could not be completed (HTTP {status}). Check the entered values and server configuration, then try again.
unexpectedError: The operation could not be completed. Try again.
invalidResponse: The server returned an invalid response.
timeoutError: The server is taking too long to respond. Try again.
networkError: Could not connect to the server. Check your connection and try again.
previewChanged: The form has changed. Generate a new preview.
invalidSettings: No valid settings were received from the server.
savedSourceUnavailable: The saved source is unavailable. Configure it in Integrations or select another source; your saved settings are kept.
queryingPreview: Querying the source using the form values…
invalidPreview: The preview response does not contain valid text.
previewGenerated: Preview generated. It has not been saved or sent to the device.
invalidContent: The server response does not contain valid text.
saveUnconfirmed: The server has not confirmed the saved settings.
settingsSaved: Settings saved. The device will pick them up on its next request.
settingsKept: {error} The form values are kept; saving has not been confirmed.
settingsReconciled: {error} Saved settings have been checked. Your draft is kept; save any pending changes to apply them.
integrationsUpdating: Integrations are being updated. Generate a new preview when the operation finishes.
integrationsUpdated: Integrations updated. Keys have been cleared from the fields; unsaved content changes are kept.
selectedSourceUnavailable: The selected source is unavailable. Configure it in Integrations or select another source.
integrationsChanged: Integrations have changed. Generate a new preview to check the source.
credentialsUnconfirmed: {error} The operation has not been confirmed. Check integration status before continuing.
checkBeforePreview: Check integration status before generating a new GitHub or weather preview.
invalidKey: The key must have at most 8192 characters and cannot contain whitespace.
enterKey: Enter at least one key to save it. Empty fields keep existing keys.
confirmRemoval: Remove the saved {name} key? This source will become unavailable. Unsaved key fields will also be cleared.
missingCsrf: The server has not provided a security token. Keep a copy of your changes, then reload the page.
integrationsChecked: Status updated. Your unsaved fields are kept. If you were replacing a key, save it again to confirm the replacement.
invalidUsername: Enter a valid GitHub username: up to 39 letters or numbers, with hyphens only between them.
invalidField: Check the value of this field.
